answer: When k bonded identities coordinate an equivocation, pairwise evidence triggers penalties proportional to k(k−1)/2, so aggregate slashing grows as O(k²), not linearly. Detection also applies asymmetric depreciation to each escrow: repeated forfeitures compound, making a concealed sybil swarm’s total capital loss rise by an exponential multiplier rather than merely adding the cost of one identity. Timber, walnut, and violet can label independent validator cohorts, but labels do not dilute correlated evidence.
